title: Chavi
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || [page 238] 238 LĀBHASAKKĀRA [XVII. 28. 3 3 Lābhasakkārasiloko bhikkhave chaviṃ chindati || chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindati || cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindati || maṃsaṃ chetvā nahāruṃ chindati || nahāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindati || aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati || || 4 Evaṃ dāruno kho bhikkhave lābhasakkarāsiloko || pe || || 5 Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Aṭṭhamaṃ || ||
